checkout.success: Checkout finished. The governed actions you bought are added to this period once Stripe confirms the payment.
checkout.cancel: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
checkout.credits: Checkout finished. The top-up is added to the token balance once Stripe confirms the payment.
checkout.plan: Checkout finished. The new plan applies once Stripe confirms the subscription.

basis.plan: {plan}, billed {interval} · {count, plural, =0 {not invoiced yet this period} one {# Stripe invoice} other {# Stripe invoices}}
basis.tokens: reported at zero · the customer’s own model spend is on Spend
basis.discount: no onboarding offer is recorded for this organization

meters.title: Meters
meters.governedNote: the billable unit · {included} included this month
meters.sealed: Sealed runs with at least one model call
meters.halted: Runs Oxagen halted before any model call
meters.note: One priced meter: the governed action, a call Oxagen decided, delivered and recorded. Runs, tokens and retained evidence are reported so the price can move later without rewriting the meter.
meters.exhaustedNoCard: <link>Add a payment method</link> to keep governing this month, or your allowance renews on {date}

mode.prepaid: Prepaid. Governed actions stop when this period's allowance runs out, unless auto top-up buys more.
mode.prepaidNoCard: Prepaid. Governed actions stop when this period's allowance runs out. Add a payment method to keep governing past it, or wait for the next month.
mode.invoice: Invoice billing. Governed actions are never capped. Overage is invoiced at period end, or once {max} governed actions accrue.
mode.pastDue: Payment past due: an interim or period-close invoice is open. Governing continues. Pay it from Invoices.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.viewLabel: Open invoice {number} on stripe.com in a new tab

priceList.title: Price list
priceList.freeTerms: every governance feature, {count} governed actions a month
priceList.blocksTerms: <price></price> per block at the published rate
priceList.negotiatedTerms: the same four figures, per organization
priceList.invoiceTerms: never capped · overage invoiced at the contracted rate at period end
priceList.retentionTerms: {months} months included on paid plans, then <price></price> per GB-month
priceList.footer: No credits, no resellers, and no revenue dashboard. The free tier is the whole product, limited by retention and seats, never by features or volume. Upgrading is a governance decision, not a volume accident.

billableUnits.title: Billable units
billableUnits.pricedBody: A governed action: a call Oxagen decided, delivered and recorded, with its receipt in the chain.
billableUnits.reportedBody: Sealed runs, tokens by class, retained evidence: secondary meters, never priced.
billableUnits.freeBody: Denials, runs Oxagen halted before a model call, runs of the in-app agent. You never pay for Oxagen saying no.

autoTopup.title: Auto top-up
autoTopup.enabled: Buy more automatically when this period's allowance runs out
autoTopup.readOnly: An owner or admin can change auto top-up.
autoTopup.invalidBlocks: Enter a whole number of blocks from 1 to 100.
autoTopup.failed: Auto top-up could not be saved. Try again.
autoTopup.savedCardUnlabelled: charged to the saved payment method
autoTopup.noCard: No saved payment method. Your next purchase saves one, and auto top-up runs from then on.

attempt.none: No auto top-up has run this month.
attempt.open: Last top-up {date}: open, its invoice is under Invoices

purchase.title: Buy governed actions
purchase.wholeBlocks: Choose a whole number of blocks to see the total
purchase.savesCard: Checkout saves your card. Auto top-up runs from then on.
purchase.denied: An owner or a billing member can buy governed actions.

errors.invalid: Choose a whole number of blocks.
errors.aboveMax: You can buy at most {max} governed actions at once.
errors.denied: Your role cannot buy governed actions. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.conflict: This organization is billed by invoice, so it does not buy governed actions in blocks.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

usageCredits.title: Token balance
usageCredits.basis: Pays for the tokens Oxagen buys for the in-app agent, at cost with no markup. The balance is the cap.
usageCredits.exhausted: The in-app agent's turns on Oxagen's model key stop until a top-up lands.
usageCredits.denied: An owner or a billing member can top up the token balance.
usageCredits.planDenied: A top-up needs a Build plan or above. Subscribe first and the top-up opens here.

errors.invalid: Enter a whole dollar amount of at least ${min}.
errors.denied: Your role cannot top up the token balance. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

changePlan.title: Change plan
changePlan.note: The free tier is in every plan: an included monthly allowance of governed actions and every governance feature on. Enterprise adds a dedicated data plane or behind-the-firewall deployment, and support with an SLA.
changePlan.checkout: Stripe Checkout shows the amount due before anything is charged.
changePlan.enterprise: Enterprise is negotiated per organization. Its terms are set on your agreement, not here.
changePlan.denied: An owner or a billing member can change the plan.
changePlan.subscribed: This organization already has a {plan} subscription. Changing a running subscription is not in the app yet. It would swap the plan in Stripe from the next renewal.

errors.denied: Your role cannot change the plan. An owner or a billing member can.
errors.conflict: This organization already has an active subscription, so Checkout cannot start a second one.
errors.unavailable: Checkout could not be opened. Nothing was charged.

failure.denied: You cannot see {section} for this organization. Your role does not include {permission}. An organization owner can grant it.
failure.pendingApproval: Access to {section} is waiting for approval, request {accessRequestId}.
failure.error: {section} could not be loaded: the billing service answered {code}. Nothing was charged.

empty.title: Nothing billable yet
empty.body: You pay per governed action: a call Oxagen decided, delivered and recorded. The free tier has every governance feature on, an included monthly allowance, thirty days of evidence and three seats.

error.title: Billing could not be loaded
error.body: The control plane answered {status} {errorCode}. Nothing was changed. Runs kept recording while this page was down. Frames are written by the collector on each host, not by Oxagen.
error.trace: trace not recorded · region not recorded · {at}

denied.title: You cannot see billing
denied.body: Your roles on {org} do not include {permission} (plan and invoices are readable only by a finance role). An organization owner can grant it. The grant is a governed action and lands in the audit record with your name on it.
denied.decidedByValue: the organization's roles · deny wins over every allow

pending.title: Access to billing is waiting for approval
pending.body: Request {request} is waiting on an organization owner.

requestAccess.title: Request access
requestAccess.body: Asking for a role from this page is not in Oxagen yet. It would send an organization owner a request for {permission} with your reason, and the grant would land in the audit record with both your names.
requestAccess.now: Until then, ask an owner to give you the billing role on the Organization page.

incident.title: Open an incident
incident.body: Filing an incident from this page is not in Oxagen yet. It would record one against the billing service with the code {code} and the time {at} attached.
incident.now: Until then, report the code and the time to your Oxagen contact.
